outcome: adherence to standard diagnostic criteria for Caesarean section indications
cohort: The study included 392 multiparous women with term, singleton pregnancies and no previous Caesarean section (Robson group 3) who underwent emergency Caesarean section at Muhimbili National Hospital.
finding: The study found that, on average, the standard diagnostic criteria for audited indications of Caesarean section were met in 55.1% of cases among low-risk women.
